thread:
Carmen Reyes: noticing a 15-30% tail latency increase for small-batch chat on canary after last deploy. Metric: https://grafana.redwood/d/... :eyes:
Ben Cho: saw the same in CI — nightly small-batch perf job regressed around 2026-03-17 03:10 UTC
Alice Patel: any infra deps bumped recently? Triton / PyTorch / CUDA?
Carmen Reyes: rolled forward Triton 2.4.1 + nvrtc minor patch in yesterday's runtime deploy (deploy id 2114980000). Bisecting now.
Ben Cho: try a git bisect on the runtime and the triton-autotune patches. Also flip on --perf-events for the CI job.
Alice Patel: quick bisect points at triton-autotune commit 3f8b7e7 (PR #4521) — it changed the kernel scoring heuristic for small GEMMs.
Diego Mendez: repro'd locally. Kernel selection flipped from 'matmul_short' -> 'matmul_tall' for seq_len<=8, which increases regs and causes shared-mem spill. nvprof snapshot:
```
matmul_short  avg 1.2ms
matmul_tall   avg 3.6ms  (higher regs, spills)
```
Carmen Reyes: also seeing KV cache prefetch hit-rate fall from 98% -> 73% on 1-token prefixes; traces show extra prefetches and cache churn (link to trace).
Ben Cho: hypothesis: nvrtc inlining/opt change increased register pressure for the short kernel variant, so autotuner now picks the tall kernel. That plus eviction pattern explains prefetch mispredictions.
Alice Patel: infra-bot: can you confirm canary status?
infra-bot: Deploy blocked: canary rollout 'rnf-canary' paused at 40% due to latency SLO breach (rule: p50/p95 > 120% baseline).
Diego Mendez: quick mitigation: patch runtime to bias kernel selection toward lower register-usage kernels when batch_size <= 8. I can open PR for the heuristic toggle.
Ben Cho: also open an upstream issue in Triton and link the autotune logs; we shouldn't revert full autotuner change unless necessary. Prefer short-term heuristic + CI guardrails.
Carmen Reyes: plan: 1) Diego opens hotfix PR to prefer low-reg kernels for small batches, 2) run canary with PR, 3) if still bad, rollback deploy; 4) triage with Triton upstream. Target hotfix deploy in next 2 hours.
Alice Patel: saving bisect output, autotune logs, and perf diffs to the incident doc: https://confluence/redwood/perf/incidents/2115006789
Ben Cho: cc'ing ops and perf on-watch.
Carmen Reyes: I'll paste the repro script and a minimal test vector in this thread after PR is up. Thanks all :thumbsup:
